title: Implement Obstacle Generation and Collision Detection
description: Develop the obstacle manager to spawn random farm-themed hazards (e.g., tractors, fences) and implement Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) collision detection between the chicken and obstacles.
acceptanceCriteria: Obstacles spawn at regular intervals with randomized heights or gaps
AABB collision function accurately detects overlap between chicken and obstacle hitboxes
tests/test_collision.py verifies correct boolean outcomes for intersecting and non-intersecting rects
